Package it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.shared.payload.servertoclient.game

package it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.shared.payload.servertoclient.game
Contains server-side game state updates sent to clients.

Includes boards, player states, turn states, and card updates to synchronize client views with the authoritative game state.
